desc:
A lost scientist. A world full of dinosaurs. ONE epic mission - get home! 🚀

Help our hero repair his broken time machine! Explore a massive prehistoric world, tame wild dinosaurs, mine rare ores, and uncover ancient secrets. Will you befriend a mighty T-Rex or zoom around with a Velociraptor? 🦕

🌟 Features
🦖 Catch & tame 100+ dinosaurs - from tiny Compys to giant Bronto bosses!
⛏️ Mine rare ores & crystals to upgrade gear and fix the time machine
🗺️ Explore huge biomes - jungles, volcanoes, frozen tundras & hidden caves
👥 Play with friends - trade dinos, team up, and conquer raid bosses together
🎁 Daily rewards, codes & weekly updates packed with new content!

🎮 Controls
[WASD] Move
[Space] Jump
[Shift] Sprint
[E] Interact / Catch
